svg.aria-label: Bélády's anomaly: FIFO with 3 frames makes 9 faults, with 4 frames 10
svg.title: Bélády's anomaly: FIFO with 3 frames makes 9 faults, with 4 frames 10
svg.text: Bélády's anomaly: FIFO with 3 frames makes 9 faults, with 4 frames 10
Circled: page fault. Each column shows the frames after the reference, newest page on top; FIFO evicts the bottom one.
LRU and OPT never do this: with more frames they always hold a superset of what they would hold with fewer (stack algorithms).
